items.exampleEn: It's normal to feel tired after a long trip.
items.exampleZh: 長途旅行後覺得累是很正常的。

items.exampleEn: Please drive slowly near the school.
This table is made of wood.

items.exampleZh: 那張桌子是什麼形狀的？

items.exampleEn: Taking the train is the quickest way to get there.
items.exampleZh: 搭火車是去那裡最快的方法。

items.exampleEn: The shop gives free samples of its cookies.
items.exampleZh: 這家店提供免費的餅乾試吃。

items.exampleEn: I walk every day to stay fit.
items.exampleZh: 我每天走路來保持健康。

items.sentenceEn: Please speak slowly. My English is not good.
items.sentenceZh: 請說慢一點，我的英文不好。

items.audioEn: The cookies come in different shapes, like stars and hearts.
items.audioZh: 這些餅乾有各種不同的形狀，像是星星和愛心。
items.questionZh: 這些餅乾有什麼特別的地方？
options: They are very big and soft

items.sentenceEn: I had a quick lunch at my desk.
items.sentenceZh: 我在辦公桌前很快地吃了午餐。

items.sentenceEn: She speaks in a soft voice.

items.stemEn: Everything is ____ today. Nothing strange happened.
items.stemZh: 今天一切正常，沒發生什麼奇怪的事。

items.stemEn: My grandfather swims every day, so he is very ____.
items.stemZh: 我爺爺每天游泳，所以身體很健康。

items.passageEn: Ben makes small toys out of wood. He works slowly and carefully. First, he cuts the wood into the right shape. Then he paints it in bright colors. At the market, children can play with a sample toy before their parents buy one. "Making toys is a normal part of my day," Ben says. "It keeps my hands busy and my mind happy."
items.passageZh: Ben 用木頭做小玩具。他做得又慢又仔細。他先把木頭切成合適的形狀，再漆上鮮豔的顏色。在市集裡，孩子們可以先玩樣品玩具，爸媽再決定要不要買。Ben 說：「做玩具是我每天的日常。它讓我的手有事做，心情也很好。」

options: 把木頭切成合適的形狀
先幫每個玩具上好顏色

questions.questionZh: 孩子們在爸媽買玩具前可以做什麼？

rubricZh: 副詞 slowly 放在動詞後面（例如 walks slowly、walks very slowly）
第三人稱單數的動詞要加 s（例如 walks）

items.promptZh: 這座島的形狀像一顆心。
referenceEn: The shape of this island is like a heart.
This island has the shape of a heart.
rubricZh: 用 shape 表示「形狀」（例如 the shape of this island、has the shape of a heart 等）
「像一顆心」可寫，例如 is like a heart、the shape of a heart 等；寫 is shaped like a heart 也正確
